description.text: The fifth Sword & Shield set, released on 19 March 2021 with 183 cards: 163 and 20 secret rares, made from the Japanese Single Strike Master and Rapid Strike Master. It brought in Single Strike and Rapid Strike, styles marked on Pokémon, Trainer and Energy cards that work together, around Urshifu, whose Gigantamax form appears as a VMAX in each style, and it turns to the games' downloadable expansion. It was the first set with the E regulation mark.
